title: cloud-search's final figure draws the MGnify set only
body:
## What exists today

cloud-search's real set has two units, built by `build-set --in cloud-search-real`: Pfam against 500,000 MGnify sequences (`pfam.mgnify`) and Pfam against 500,000 Swissprot sequences (`pfam.swissprot`). `cloud-search plot` draws the `(A, B)` surfaces for both.

## The change

The final figure draws the MGnify unit only. Swissprot leaves the figure.
